description: Configuration for Chicago Open Data ingestion, budget appropriations, and preprocessing

budget_appropriations_2025.title: Budget - 2025 Budget Ordinance - Appropriations
budget_appropriations_2025.notes: Represents authorized legal spending ceilings enacted by City Council, not final audited expenditures.

mid_year_grants_925.title: Mid-Year Grants 925
mid_year_grants_925.notes: Tracks active grant commitments, encumbrances, and project-to-date expenditures.

crash_severity_weights.notes: Weights partitioned across disjoint injury categories to avoid double-counting injuries and fatalities.

research_notes: Appropriations in t59y-fr3k represent authorized spending limits voted by City Council, not final expenditures.
Grants in iyu8-jkf8 report committed and expended funds for specific multi-year grant projects.
5,000-row sample is used for rapid integration validation and pipeline testing, not full empirical inference.
Historical end-of-month backlog is reconstructed using creation and closure timestamps; intermediate status changes are not captured by portal.
Traffic safety metric is an Equivalent Property Damage Only (EPDO) severity score normalized to [0.0, 1.0], not a crash probability.
Coverage across all 77 Chicago Community Areas is analyzed systematically before sub-grouping.
